title: Porch Light Waltz
short: Teddy Rook Book (original) · G 3/4 · play it with every note lit.

blocks.html: Old-time and bluegrass bands slow down for a waltz at the end of the evening, and the banjo rolls along in threes. This one is our own. Each bar is six eighth notes: one roll, with the melody note on the first beat. Most bars use the forward roll from the thumb or the index finger; bar 13 uses the backward roll (M I T). Let the open strings ring, and play the first note of each bar a little louder.

blocks.name: music-player
blocks.cap: Play it: the score scrolls, the keys or strings light up as each note sounds.

blocks.html: The piece: A slow waltz in G, written for this course in the style of the country waltzes played at Southern dances

sources.name: Original composition by Teddy Rook Book for this course (no source needed); the rolls are the standard three-finger patterns.
